availability_semantics: Implementation description, not continuous source health or an executed analysis.

modules.title: Bitcoin source
modules.description: Read a bounded best-chain block sample with confirmation depth and a repeated block-hash check.
modules.limits: First 20 transactions; up to 24 inputs and outputs per transaction. Earlier pages move to an earlier block.

modules.title: Ethereum source
modules.description: Read source-finalized Ethereum blocks and successful direct-value transaction receipts.
modules.limits: Up to 24 eligible native transactions per page. Internal calls are outside this sample.

modules.title: USDT transfer logs
modules.description: Read Transfer logs from the configured Ethereum USDT contract.
modules.limits: Up to 512 logs across four blocks. Contract identity stays separate from the token symbol.

modules.title: USDC transfer logs
modules.description: Read Transfer logs from the configured Ethereum USDC contract.
modules.limits: Other chains and bridged versions are outside this adapter. Dense windows disclose truncation.

modules.title: Bloch source
modules.description: Read indexed Bloch transactions and script references with a source snapshot cursor.
modules.limits: 32 transactions and up to 3,000 records per page. Missing timestamps and unavailable finality remain explicit.

modules.title: Official list snapshots
modules.description: Existing operator jobs capture official OFAC snapshot metadata for separate research.
modules.limits: The System Map does not query the private list store or perform identifier screening.

modules.title: Space observations
modules.description: Open network overviews, block series and Bloch peer telemetry in Bloch Space.
modules.limits: Series and Graphus graph samples are separate observations with different sampling windows.

modules.title: UTXO normalization
modules.description: Preserve observed input previous-output references and created outputs as separate record types.
modules.limits: An input does not identify an owner. Input and output amounts are not summed into transfer-volume claims.

modules.title: Native ETH normalization
modules.description: Keep successful native-value transfers with their transaction, receipt and block references.
modules.limits: Internal contract calls and unreturned transactions are not represented.

modules.title: USDT normalization
modules.description: Preserve fixed-contract log identity, direction and exact integer token amounts.
modules.limits: Zero-address endpoints are chain references, not holder identities.

modules.title: USDC normalization
modules.description: Preserve block, transaction and log position for each returned token transfer.
modules.limits: Amounts remain base-unit strings and are not converted to floating point.

modules.title: Bloch normalization
modules.description: Keep spent outpoint references and created outputs attached to their indexed transactions.
modules.limits: Script references do not imply beneficial ownership.

modules.title: Exact list matching
modules.description: An existing private prototype compares exact identifiers against versioned official snapshots.
modules.limits: No screening result is returned by this public workbench. A source match would require separate verification.

modules.title: Asset registry
modules.description: Maintain the five supported assets and their network-specific interpretation.
modules.limits: Cross-chain symbols do not establish asset equivalence.

modules.title: Source manifest
modules.description: Inspect the source, retrieval time, block anchor and sampling windows of the collected pages.
modules.limits: The manifest reports the upstream observation; it is not independent consensus verification.

modules.title: Canonical event sample
modules.description: Validate reference endpoints, event IDs, exact amounts and block anchors before local analysis.
modules.limits: Graphus detects duplicate events and conflicting anchors; full-chain indexing is not implied.

modules.title: Coverage diagnostics
modules.description: Measure which returned records contain transaction, amount, block and timestamp fields.
modules.limits: These are record-completeness checks. They do not estimate missing network activity.

modules.title: Evidence export
modules.description: Export full or filtered public-chain collections with source lineage and compare a pinned baseline.
modules.limits: The digest identifies exported bytes and does not establish source truth. No AML verdict or person data is generated.

modules.title: Private customer context
modules.description: A future separate store could hold purpose-bound customer context for explicitly authorized workflows.
modules.limits: Identity resolution, customer uploads and IP-based inference are not implemented in this module.

modules.title: Dataset retention
modules.description: The BI-PoRB portal retains the latest 50 analyses per organization, including source and model metadata.
modules.limits: Public workbench captures stay in memory until exported or cleared.

modules.title: Correction lineage
modules.description: Track revisions, withdrawn observations and downstream findings that need recalculation.
modules.limits: A case correction workflow has not been deployed.

modules.title: Transaction graph
modules.description: Inspect transaction identifiers, saved evidence collections and directed records in Constellation and the portal.
modules.limits: Graph adjacency does not establish continuity of value across different transactions.

modules.title: UTXO reference graph
modules.description: Keep wallet/script references and transaction nodes distinct in input/output graphs.
modules.limits: Co-occurrence is not an ownership cluster.

modules.title: Account / token graph
modules.description: Explore recorded native and token events with per-asset graph boundaries.
modules.limits: The current graph does not classify address holders or infer contract operators.

modules.title: Observed balances
modules.description: Open Oculum for real balance queries, discovery samples and comparison of observations.
modules.limits: Discovery is a bounded activity sample. It is not a complete global holder ranking.

modules.title: Directed paths
modules.description: Find bounded directed paths in the collected Constellation sample.
modules.limits: A topological path is not necessarily chronological or a continuous transfer of the same value.

modules.title: Bridge evidence
modules.description: Offline research requires source transaction, message, receipt and asset mapping for cross-chain edges.
modules.limits: No public cross-chain value bridge is inferred from timing alone.

modules.title: Claim separation
modules.description: Keep source facts, external assertions and analytic hypotheses as separate evidence types.
modules.limits: The live graph currently displays chain observations, without external identity or allegation labels.

modules.title: Structural statistics
modules.description: Analyze degree, connected components, concentration and observed graph shapes in Analytics.
modules.limits: Patterns describe the sample and carry no judgment about a reference.

modules.title: Observation features
modules.description: Compute event counts, adjacent references, exact-amount transforms, directional balance and active blocks.
modules.limits: Source amounts remain exact; modeling transforms are sample-relative.

modules.title: Isolation Forest
modules.description: BI-PoRB computes descriptive structural isolation with 64 deterministic trees.
inputs: At least three distinct feature vectors
modules.limits: Red is not a validated AML, ownership or credit assessment. Insufficient cohorts return no Red value.

modules.title: Record completeness
modules.description: BI-PoRB Blue summarizes observed block, transaction, amount and timestamp completeness.
modules.limits: Blue measures these returned fields, not truth, identity or full-chain coverage.

modules.title: Historical evaluation
modules.description: Explore Space series with rolling statistics, correlations, clustering and historical AR(1) evaluation.
modules.limits: Missing observations and changes in telemetry coverage break training segments.

modules.title: AML evidence preparation
modules.description: Assemble public transaction observations, coverage diagnostics and exact source records for subsequent authorized review.
modules.limits: This preparation module produces data only. It does not perform sanctions matching or assign an AML judgment.

modules.title: Monitoring rules
modules.description: Future organization-defined rules can evaluate documented data conditions and route records for review.
modules.limits: Automated monitoring schedules, alert delivery and validated detection rules are not deployed.

modules.title: ZK proof research
modules.description: Research a proof of a bounded deterministic transform or inference with pinned inputs.
modules.limits: No production proof generator or verifier is available. A proof would not establish source accuracy.

modules.title: Public explorer
modules.description: Open public chain-reference search, graph collection, source evidence and observed balances.
modules.limits: Public views contain no private portal scores or customer cases.

modules.title: Private Red / Blue
modules.description: Open the invitation-only BI-PoRB workspace for saved observations and descriptive Red/Blue results.
modules.limits: Email invitation access is implemented; it does not constitute identity verification or AML certification.

modules.title: Case review
modules.description: A future case workspace can group evidence, reviewer actions and corrections without converting graph proximity into a finding.
modules.limits: Case creation, adjudication and appeals are not implemented. Source records can already be inspected in BI-PoRB.

modules.title: Integration API keys
modules.description: Owners and admins create scoped, expiring API keys for their organization.
modules.limits: Keys expire after 1–90 days and can be revoked. A market-sector label grants no permissions.

modules.title: Invitations & roles
modules.description: Invite an email as administrator, analyst or viewer and manage organization membership.
modules.limits: Invitations are email-bound and expire after 48 hours. Only owners can invite administrators.

modules.title: Access audit
modules.description: Review recorded portal authentication, collection and administration events.
modules.limits: Raw passwords, API keys and request bodies are excluded from audit entries.

modules.title: Data APIs
modules.description: Inspect public bounded chain APIs and the private BI-PoRB integration contract.
modules.limits: Public and private APIs have separate authorization and coverage.

modules.title: Field catalog
modules.description: Browse Graphus field definitions and their source, access and coverage expectations.
modules.limits: A defined field is not a promise that every source supplies it.

connections.contract: Versioned official source files · private research only
Potential exact-match evidence · future review gate
Private portal storage uses a separate authenticated collection
Public references for separate balance queries
Exact records for private sample features
Optional observation context for future case workflows
Research-only bridge evidence; absent from live graph paths
